narrative: 喜剧、天堂、医院和糖果店都活在这里，因为这个世界看起来安全、干净，或人工地完美。即使在高调布光（High-Key Lighting）的画面里，浓烈的色彩依然可以存在；阴影只是不会压到纯黑。
在这种明亮之中出现一段酸涩的表演，也能证明这种承诺是虚假的。对于犯罪、夜晚，或任何需要一个藏身之处的段落来说，它就不是合适的工具。
明亮不等于过曝。如果每个表面都是同一片白，你就失去了材质和面部细节。
how: 使用大光源、充足的补光，并常常借助墙面和天花板的反射光，让比例接近2:1或更低。主光依然可以有侧向性；只是不会形成一道悬崖式的落差。
保护皮肤、糖霜、墙面的高光细节。颜色常常是日光平衡或适合柔和色调的，有时略偏冷以表现无菌空间，有时是糖果般的暖色。
提示词：High-key lighting on [Subject], bright even illumination, minimal shadows, airy overexposure by a third, optimism or sterile future.
when: 用于喜剧室内、展示间、医院，或应该显得开放的玩具世界。不要把它当作过曝的同义词，也不要在凶案现场使用它，除非你想要反讽效果。
vs: 低调布光（Low-Key Lighting）是相反的比例：选择性布光，大面积阴影。柔光是硬度概念；你可以有柔和的低调布光。
魅力光（Glam）用一个大主光来出售一张脸，但仍然可以置身于反差较大的房间里。浮雕光（Cameo Lighting）把人物孤立在黑暗中，正好与开放式的高调布光世界相反。
examples_film: 《瑟堡的雨伞》（The Umbrellas of Cherbourg）让色彩鲜艳的室内保持开放的照明，使浪漫显得人工而清晰。《芭比》（Barbie）把芭比乐园打造成一个受控的明亮世界，并保留高光细节。
《2001太空漫游》（2001: A Space Odyssey）中的“发现号”空间使用高调布光，保持干净而不是死黑一片。《绝代艳后》（Marie Antoinette）常常置身于光亮的房间之中。
mistakes: 最常见的误用，是过曝，或在暗室中使用柔光。破绽是墙面死白，或者一张明亮的脸出现在黑色虚空中（那是浮雕光）。
解决办法是降低整个布景的反差，并保留高光细节。

faq.q: 电影中的高调布光是什么？
faq.a: 一种低反差、明亮的布光方案，几乎没有深色阴影。场景依然可以有色彩和一定的立体感；它并不自动等于过曝。

faq.q: 高调布光和低调布光有什么区别？
faq.a: 高调布光保持画面开放、比例较低。低调布光使用高反差，让画面大部分陷入阴影。

faq.q: 什么时候该用高调布光？
faq.a: 用于喜剧、无菌空间、展示间，或糖果般明亮的世界。当黑暗必须隐藏信息时，就不要用它。

faq.q: AI 图像或视频中如何提示高调布光？
faq.a: 指明明亮均匀的照明、极少的阴影、大光源，并保留高光质感。说明过曝程度不超过三分之一档。

narrative: Comedy, heaven, hospital, and candy shops live here because the world looks safe, clean, or artificially perfect. Strong colors can still sit in a high-key frame; the shadows simply do not go to black.
A sour performance inside that brightness can also prove the promise is false. It is the wrong tool for crime, night, or any beat that needs a hiding place.
Bright is not the same as blown. If every surface is the same white, you lost material and face.
how: Use large sources, plenty of fill, and often bounce from walls and ceiling so the ratio sits near 2:1 or lower. Key can still have a side; it is just not a cliff.
Protect highlight detail on skin, icing, walls. Color is often daylight-balanced or pastel-friendly, sometimes slightly cool for sterile spaces, sometimes candy-warm.
Prompt: High-key lighting on [Subject], bright even illumination, minimal shadows, airy overexposure by a third, optimism or sterile future.
when: Use it for a comic interior, a showroom, a hospital, or a toy world that should feel open. Do not use it as a synonym for overexposure, and do not use it on a murder scene unless you want irony.
vs: Low-key lighting is the opposite ratio: selective light and substantial shadow. Soft light is hardness; you can have soft low-key.
Glam sells a face with a large key but can still sit in a contrasty room. Cameo lighting isolates a figure in black, the reverse of an open high-key world.
examples_film: The Umbrellas of Cherbourg keeps brightly colored interiors openly lit so romance is artificial and clear. Barbie builds Barbieland as a carefully controlled bright world with preserved highlight detail.
2001: A Space Odyssey uses high-key Discovery spaces that stay clean rather than crushed. Marie Antoinette often lives in luminous rooms.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is overexposure or soft light in a dark room. The tell is clipped walls, or a bright face in a black void (cameo).
Fix it by lowering contrast across the whole set and holding highlight detail.

faq.q: What is high-key lighting in film?
faq.a: A low-contrast, bright setup with limited deep shadow. The scene can still have color and some modeling; it is not automatically overexposed.
High-key keeps the frame open and the ratio low. Low-key uses high contrast and lets most of the frame fall into shadow.

faq.q: When should I use high-key lighting?
faq.a: Use it for comedy, sterile spaces, showrooms, or candy-bright worlds. Do not use it when darkness must hide information.

faq.q: How do I prompt high-key lighting for AI image or video?
faq.a: Specify bright even illumination, minimal shadows, large sources, and highlight texture preserved. Say overexposure by no more than a third.
